description: An Engagement Visual from Enlighten Designs Enlighten AI Storyteller uses Open AI to transform your data into compelling narratives, going beyond traditional visualizations by dynamically generating natural language summaries of your live data. High-level insights and a clearer understanding of your datasets. Customization Enlighten Storyteller lets you select from different storytelling styles to jazz up your summary.
